message.content:
Here are some notable players who have played for the Los Angeles Clippers (in no particular order):

- **Kawhi Leonard** – Guard (2019–2023)
- **Paul George** – Guard (2013–2019, 2020–2023)
- **Chris Paul** – Guard (2007–2011, 2014–2015)
- **Julius Randle** – Forward (2018–2023)
- **Blake Griffin** – Forward (2009–2015, 2017–2019)
- **DeAndre Jordan** – Center (2008–2015, 2017–2020)
- **Jamal Crawford** – Guard (2004–2007, 2010–2011)
- **Kyrie Irving** – Guard (2011–2012)
- **Julius Erving** – Forward (1972–1973) – early history before the franchise became the Clippers
- **Gary Payton** – Guard (1995–1996)

These are just a few of the many players who have worn the Clippers jersey over the years. If you want a more comprehensive list or details about a specific era, let me know!
